# InvertedStone

> > InvertedStone provides AI pricing calculators, automation tools, and resources for optimizing costs across OpenAI, Claude, OpenRouter, and other LLM providers.

Created by Vempus Technologies, InvertedStone helps developers and businesses estimate API costs, integrate AI models with platforms like Airtable and Google Sheets, and implement cost-effective AI solutions. The site features interactive calculators for major providers and practical tutorials for AI automation workflows.

## Key Topics

- OpenAI API pricing
- Claude (Opus 4.6, Sonnet, Haiku)
- OpenRouter API
- Token pricing and cost optimization
- Airtable automation
- Google Sheets integration
- GPT-4o and ChatGPT
- Gemini and DeepSeek models
- Embedding APIs
- Cohere Command models
- AI model cost calculators
- LLM pricing comparison
- Cost reduction strategies
- Multi-model AI workflows

## AI Pricing Calculators

- [Free Online Calculators, Tools, and Utilities](https://invertedstone.com/calculators): Collection of free AI pricing calculators and cost estimation tools
- [Claude API Pricing Calculator 2026](https://invertedstone.com/calculators/claude-pricing): Calculate Anthropic Claude API costs with prompt caching and batch discounts
- [OpenRouter Models Pricing Calculator](https://invertedstone.com/calculators/openrouter-pricing): Compare OpenRouter model costs across Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, and Google
- [Embedding API Pricing Calculator](https://invertedstone.com/calculators/embedding-pricing-calculator): Calculate OpenAI text embedding costs for ada-002 and embedding-3 models
- [Cohere API Pricing Calculator 2026](https://invertedstone.com/calculators/cohere-pricing): Calculate Cohere Command model API costs with per-token estimates

## AI Automation Tools & Products

- [Multi AI Airtable Script 4.0 - 300+ AI Models](https://invertedstone.com/store/multi-ai-airtable-script): Airtable script with 300+ AI models via OpenRouter for multimodal processing

## Cost Optimization & Pricing Guides

- [9 Effective Ways to Reduce OpenAI API Costs](https://invertedstone.com/blog/effective-ways-to-reduce-openai-api-costs): 9 strategies for optimizing and reducing OpenAI API token costs
- [How Much is OpenAI 1k Tokens?](https://invertedstone.com/blog/how-much-is-openai-1k-tokens): Detailed breakdown of OpenAI token pricing for GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 models
- [Does OpenAI Playground Cost Money?](https://invertedstone.com/blog/does-openai-playground-cost-money): Explanation of OpenAI Playground pricing, free credits, and API costs

## Integration Tutorials

- [How to Connect OpenRouter API to Google Sheets](https://invertedstone.com/blog/connect-openrouter-to-google-sheets): Tutorial for connecting OpenRouter API to Google Sheets via Apps Script
- [How to Connect OpenRouter API to Airtable](https://invertedstone.com/blog/connect-openrouter-to-airtable): Guide to integrate OpenRouter API with Airtable for AI automation
- [Get Outputs from Local LLMs to Google Sheets](https://invertedstone.com/blog/local-llms-to-google-sheets): Connect local LLMs like llama2 and mistral to Google Sheets via Ollama

## AI Use Cases & Applications

- [How to Bulk Generate Product Descriptions Using AI](https://invertedstone.com/blog/generate-product-descriptions-using-ai): Bulk generate product descriptions using GPT-4 and Airtable automation
- [How to Extract Text from Images in ChatGPT](https://invertedstone.com/blog/extract-text-from-images-in-code-interpreter): Guide to extract text from images using ChatGPT and GPT-4 OCR capabilities
